title: Room relay on Cloudflare with a token check, a status read and a drop for deleted users

tasks.title: Worker and Durable Object from the reader's relay, tested in workerd through Miniflare
Token check on upgrade and identity on join
Status read and the drop for deleted users

acs.text: WHEN a WebSocket upgrade arrives at `/r/<roomId>` from an Origin on `ALLOWED_ORIGINS` THE SYSTEM SHALL hand it to the Durable Object named after that room id, which runs the room from `@sefaria-social/session`, so two sockets in one room receive each other's presence; a path whose id does not match `^[A-Za-z0-9_-]{8,128}$` gets 404, a request without `Upgrade: websocket` 426, and any other Origin 403. The tests run in the Workers runtime (workerd through Miniflare).
scenarios: Two sockets in one room see each other
Bad paths, plain requests and foreign Origins are refused

acs.text: WHEN an upgrade carries no token, or a token that fails verification against `JWKS_URL` (RS256 signature, `iss` equal to `TOKEN_ISSUER`, `aud` `sefaria-social`, not expired) THE SYSTEM SHALL answer 401 before any room sees it. The token is read only from `Sec-WebSocket-Protocol` (offered as `sefaria-social.v1, bearer.<token>`); a token in the URL is ignored, and an accepted socket answers with the subprotocol `sefaria-social.v1` alone.
scenarios: No token or a bad token is refused before the room
An accepted socket names only the protocol

acs.text: WHEN a verified socket sends `join` THE SYSTEM SHALL replace the participant's `id` with the token's `sub` and `name` with the token's `name`, so nobody can join as someone else.

WHEN `GET /internal/status/<roomId>` is called with `Authorization: Bearer <RELAY_INTERNAL_SECRET>` THE SYSTEM SHALL answer `{ref, title, participants}`: `ref` and `title` from the `social.summary` slice of the spotlight holder's stream and `participants` the number joined, or `{ref: null, title: null, participants: 0}` for a room nobody is in; it does not otherwise read reader snapshots. Without the right secret it answers 401.

WHEN `POST /internal/drop-user` is called with the secret and `{userId, rooms}` THE SYSTEM SHALL close that user's sockets in those rooms and refuse that user's upgrades to any room for 30 minutes (longer than a token lives); without the right secret it answers 401 and drops nobody.
scenarios: A deleted user is dropped and kept out
